legacy_migration.trigger: A locked original script establishes a public, object-mediated contest in which a later competence or identity reclassification must remain unrevealed until a visible result
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Before the decisive state, register performer/opponent relation, object/target zone and at least one witness layer; do not let framing labels invent who is underestimated, authoritative or likely to win
legacy_migration.coverage: Shared room/group relation → principal pair/singles → target/object state only when script state changes → selected receiver layer
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock performer line, target direction, opponent side and witness zones; preserve vessel/crowd traffic without crossing or duplicating principal identities
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Make geometry readable before object-scale inserts; do not insert the target after every exchange, and do not reveal the decisive state early
legacy_migration.sound: UNKNOWN; no challenge line, wager cue, silence, impact sound, score announcement or crowd response is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Public demonstrations, judged games, auditions, tests or object-mediated skill reveals where the locked script defines who performs, what result matters and who can see it
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Private disclosure, purely verbal dispute, invisible/aural proof, deliberate spatial confusion, or a result whose target cannot safely/legibly be shown
legacy_migration.failure_mode: The target appears without a stable performer/opponent relation; equal-weight face coverage erases hierarchy; an early object insert leaks the result; crowd geometry or screen sides drift
legacy_migration.counterexample: `BETTER-CALL-SAUL-S03E05-PUBLIC-PROOF-001` / `BCS-S03E05-C01-REGISTER-PUBLIC-PROOF-GEOMETRY` is a different-trigger boundary: a formal public proof needs distinct receiver layers and display custody, not merely a performer-target-witness triangle. legacy_migration.fallback: Use a project-original simplified floor plan with one performer mark, one opponent mark, one locked target still and two witness clusters; fixed master plus clean singles; no provider-specific prompt syntax

legacy_migration.trigger: A locked script confirms a decisive public result and specifies that several people or clusters update differently, with at least one next action or relationship beat depending on those updates
legacy_migration.directing_decision: After the result is visually readable, select distinct body/contact/group states by next narrative action rather than giving every witness an equal close-up or synchronized response
legacy_migration.coverage: Result object → one table/group layer → selected individual receiver → principal loser/winner check-backs only if script-defined → contact/action beat → room/group tail
legacy_migration.blocking: Keep each receiver in its registered zone; preserve who initiates contact, hand/body positions, vessels and crowd density; do not label visible faces as victory, defeat or approval without script facts
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Use short views for simple state registration and longer holds only for a new contact/action state; this source's durations are evidence, not a formula
legacy_migration.sound: UNKNOWN; no cheer, silence, gasp, toast, score call, music or dialogue response is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Public results with multiple script-defined receivers whose subsequent actions differ
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Only one meaningful receiver; result remains unresolved; urgent action replaces receipt; the principal turn has not finished; a receiver shot would leak hidden knowledge
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Everyone changes together; receiver order precedes the result; micro-expressions are over-labeled; contact appears without initiator/continuity; crowd or vessel identities duplicate/drift
legacy_migration.counterexample: `BETTER-CALL-SAUL-S03E05-PUBLIC-PROOF-001` / `BCS-S03E05-C03-SUSTAIN-CONTESTED-PERSON-SCREEN-OWNERSHIP` is a contrary sequencing mechanism while one person's continuous turn remains primary: external receivers are deferred until that turn completes.
legacy_migration.unknown: That `S129–S147` shares one stimulus; score, winner/loser, reversal, changed status, relationship meaning, consent, individual knowledge, reaction causes, dialogue and sound
legacy_migration.ai_risk: CRITICAL: many identities, asynchronous expressions, object/vessel continuity, contact choreography, eyelines and crowd density
legacy_migration.fallback: Cap the project-original response network at three script-required receiver layers; one fixed shot per updated state; split contact into approach/contact/release; finish on a simplified room or action tail
legacy_migration.evidence_shots: board-centered state `S128`; table/person cascade `S129–S134`; P-B/P-D contact and principal check-backs `S135–S138`; P-C/P-A contact `S139–S143`; table/group tail `S144–S147`
